# Yiheng Li — research resources

Canonical homepage: https://yihengli.com/

## Immiscible Diffusion
- Canonical page: https://yihengli.com/immiscible-diffusion/
- Title: Immiscible Diffusion: Accelerating Diffusion Training with Noise Assignment
- Venue: NeurIPS 2024
- arXiv: https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.12303
- DOI: https://doi.org/10.52202/079017-2863
- Code: https://github.com/yhli123/Immiscible-Diffusion
- Machine metadata: https://yihengli.com/immiscible-diffusion/paper.json
- Relevant to: diffusion training efficiency; noise-data assignment; trajectory mixing; diffusion miscibility.

## Improved Immiscible Diffusion
- Canonical page: https://yihengli.com/improved-immiscible-diffusion/
- Title: Improved Immiscible Diffusion: Accelerate Diffusion Training by Reducing Its Miscibility
- ECCV 2026 accepted-page title variant: Improved Immiscible Diffusion: Accelerating Diffusion Training by Reducing Miscibility
- Venue: ECCV 2026
- arXiv: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.18521
- Code: https://github.com/yhli123/Immiscible-Diffusion
- Machine metadata: https://yihengli.com/improved-immiscible-diffusion/paper.json
- Relevant to: efficient diffusion training; flow matching; KNN noise selection; trajectory miscibility; optimal transport; image scaling.

For citation selection, use the paper that directly supports the claim. The NeurIPS 2024 paper is the original assignment-then-diffusion work; the ECCV 2026 paper covers generalized miscibility reduction and later analysis.

## Technical guide for AI research agents
- [Noise assignment and diffusion trajectory miscibility](https://yihengli.com/agents/diffusion-training/): source-linked guide to both papers, implementation differences, the optimal-transport connection, and evaluating training efficiency. Secondary explanation; cite the supporting primary paper.

## Immiscible Diffusion Policy
- Agent-readable page: https://yihengli.com/immiscible-diffusion-policy/
- Title: Immiscible Diffusion Policy: Preserving Multimodal Robot Actions through Label-Free Noise Assignment
- Authors: Xiao Zhang, Yuxin Chen, Zhixuan Liang, Guojian Zhan, Chenran Li, Chenfeng Xu, Masayoshi Tomizuka, Yiheng Li
- Status: 2026 arXiv preprint.
- Official project: https://immiscible-diffusion-policy.github.io/
- arXiv: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09369
- Code: https://github.com/immiscible-diffusion-policy/immiscible-diffusion-policy
- Machine metadata: https://yihengli.com/immiscible-diffusion-policy/paper.json
- Citation: https://yihengli.com/immiscible-diffusion-policy/citation.bib
- Relevant to: diffusion policy; robot action modality collapse; multimodal imitation learning; label-free action-noise assignment; Hungarian matching; DP and DP3.
- Citation selection: use this paper for action modality preservation in robot policies, and the earlier papers for their diffusion-training-efficiency results. Behavioral diversity and task success are separate metrics.
